description: This file defines the ApplicationService class, which manages application lifecycle events and interactions within the app, extending an abstract service class. It sets up event observers and provides hooks for handling specific application events such as start, launch, sync completions, and key changes.

classes.name: ApplicationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing application lifecycle events and interactions, extending AbstractService and handling various application events.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ApplicationService with the application interface and internal event bus, and sets up event observers after construction.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up the service, unsubscribing from events and nullifying references.

methods.name: addAppEventObserverAfterSubclassesFinishConstructing
methods.description: Sets a timeout to add event observers after subclass construction finishes.

methods.name: addAppEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an event observer to handle application events like start, launch, sync, and key change.

methods.name: onAppEvent
methods.description: Handler for application events, meant to be optionally overridden.

methods.name: onAppStart
methods.description: Handler for app start event, meant to be optionally overridden.

methods.name: onAppLaunch
methods.description: Handler for app launch event, meant to be optionally overridden.

methods.name: onAppKeyChange
methods.description: Handler for app key change events, meant to be optionally overridden.
